description: This file defines the RendererInterface in Drupal, an interface specifying methods for rendering structured arrays into HTML, managing render contexts, and handling cacheability and dependencies within Drupal's rendering system.

methods.name: renderRoot
methods.description: Renders final HTML from a structured array, replacing placeholders, intended for final output just before sending a response.

methods.name: renderInIsolation
methods.description: Renders HTML in a context where no assets are needed, useful for tokens or emails, in isolation from other render contexts.

methods.name: renderPlain
methods.description: Deprecated method for rendering plain HTML; replaced by renderInIsolation.

methods.name: renderPlaceholder
methods.description: Renders a specific placeholder in isolation within a structured array.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method to render a structured array into HTML, supporting caching, theming, and nested rendering logic.

methods.name: hasRenderContext
methods.description: Checks if a render context is currently active.

methods.name: executeInRenderContext
methods.description: Executes a callable within a specified render context, tracking bubbleable metadata.

methods.name: mergeBubbleableMetadata
methods.description: Merges bubbleable rendering metadata from one render array into another.

methods.name: addCacheableDependency
methods.description: Adds a cache dependency to a render array, merging cacheability metadata.
